facts.fact: Fraternite Matin, citing GSMA, says the UEMOA had over 130 million mobile money accounts in 2024, nearly 40% active, and telecoms handle over 80% of electronic transactions.

Fraternite Matin reports PI-SPI, launched by the BCEAO on 30 September 2025, lets users transfer instantly between bank accounts, mobile money wallets and microfinance accounts, with 80 institutions connected.
